name: Blood pressure
seoDescription: In Omshree Sidha Hospital we have effective treatment for High and low Blood Pressure. Normally for low blood pressure patients are not getting good treatment.
contentHtml:
In Omshree Sidha Hospital we have effective treatment for High and low Blood Pressure. Normally for low blood pressure patients are not getting good treatment.  We have highly effective treatment for this low blood pressure.  We have special medicines and treatment techniques, which will give you the best result in a short time itself. You have to come here for a 3 weeks treatment.  We are using Panchakarma (detoxification) techniques such as Abyanga (massage) along with one or more of the following is prescribed according to the patient’s condition (Shirodara, Elakizhi, podikizhi, NjavaraKizhi/Njavarapayasam, Snehanam, Swedanam, Virechana, Vasthi, Nasyam),  as per the requirement of the patient, plus internal and external medication. This kind of treatment will slowly remove toxins, tension, reduce fat deposits, remove pain, stiffness, swelling etc and will bring back blood circulation to the normal level.   Our treatment helps to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.  You have to continue the medicines for at least 3 to 6 months, rare cases it may take some more time.

Blood pressure is the pressure of your blood pushing upon the walls of your arteries/blood vessels. During each heartbeat, blood pressure varies between a maximum (systolic) and a minimum (diastolic) pressure. The blood pressure in the circulation is due to the pumping action of the heart. High Blood Pressure may lead to heart failure, stroke, coronary heart disease, kidney failure etc .. and may affect lungs, brain and heart.

Blood Pressure whether it is high or low will cause many problems. A very good percentage of people all over the world is affected by blood pressure.  The causes are different. Some of them are Stress, Chronic kidney disease, thyroid disorders, Adrenal gland tumors, sleep apnea, smoking, overweight, lack of physical activity, alcohol, use of too much salt, genetics, family history of high blood pressure, certain defects in blood vessels, certain medications like birth control pils, cold remedies, decongestants etc…   We have effective treatment for Blood pressure.  We must know the reason and treat it at its root cause.   If it is due to tension, we will remove it, for lasting solution, we have to solve the problem, which causes tension.

Medicine

We are using pure Ayurvedic/herbal/natural medicines for the treatment of Blood Pressure. We have our own special medicines, and prepares medicines according to the conditions and requirements of the patients. Medicines vary with condition of the patient. We have our own Medicine Manufacturing unit, having GMP Certificate. We use quality materials for the manufacture of these quality medicines.

Benefits of our treatment

  1. Normally patients will feel much better in one or two weeks.  They will feel relaxed and their mind become more peaceful.
  2. Our treatment and medicines are equally good in hyper and hypo (low and high) blood pressure.
  3. It helps to prevent  heart failure, avoid stroke, etc..
  4. It is highly cost effective.
  5. You can have a normal life and able to enjoy the life without any restrictions.
  6. You will be able to save your precious time and money, otherwise you have to spend for the treatment.
  7. Our treatment helps to remove the side effects of medicines that you have taken earlier.

Duration of the treatment

Normally the patients have to undergo the therapy for three weeks, rare cases it may take more time.  Patients have to continue the medications for at least three to six months. Rare cases the duration may increase.

A full checkup just before starting the treatment and immediately after the treatment will help you to evaluate the treatment, and gives you more satisfaction.
